name: AppLanguageMask
meaning: g_langMask 0x57910A, the single-bit language selector produced by App_GetLanguageMask 0x4035EF and consumed by every TextRes_LoadString call. The switch is on GetUserDefaultLangID() & 0xFF (0x4035fe), not PRIMARYLANGID (& 0x3FF); the values below are that low byte. The constants are LANGMASK_*: src/sdk/win32.h's LANG_* are the SDK's LANGIDs (App_GetLanguageMask switches on those).

name: LANGMASK_FRENCH
meaning: LANGID & 0xFF == 0xC, and the fallback for every unlisted language.

name: LANGMASK_PORTUGUESE
meaning: LANGID & 0xFF == 0x16; the language InputDevice_GetObjectName 0x4071B0 has its hard-coded space-bar fix for.
